title: tradesQuery request
description: Query the trades of one market (marketId), or the trades of the markets whose delivery starts in [startTime, endTime). A query without marketId needs both startTime and endTime; with marketId the range is optional. A range may span at most 86400 seconds (1 day): endTime - startTime <= 86400 and endTime >= startTime. Other requests are answered with success=false and error.code TIME_RANGE_TOO_LARGE or INVALID_TIME_RANGE.

marketId.description: Market ID as UUID or 0x-prefixed 16-byte hex. Takes precedence over the time range.

endTime.description: Exclusive range end, RFC 3339. At most 1 day after startTime.
